goalZh: 会用 we / they + are 说一群人,用 isn't / aren't 纠正说错的信息,并问答大学几年级
canDoZh: 能说出自己和朋友是几年级的学生,用 we / they 介绍一群人,并用 isn't / aren't 纠正别人说错的信息

newItems.noteZh: u 读 /ʌ/,嘴巴放松、短促,不要读成“克拉布”;美国大学开学有社团招新日,一般叫 club fair。
sign 的 g 不发音;连读成 "sai-nup"。报名参加某个活动说 sign up for…:sign up for the club。
开头的 w 不发音,和 right 读音一样;write your name 写下你的名字。
问名字说 What's your name?;表格上的 name 一般要写全名,只写名的地方会标 first name。
重音在第二个音节 bi-OL-o-gy;说专业不加冠词:My major is biology.。
k 不发音,和 no 读音一样;不知道说 I don't know.;认识一个人也用 know:Do you know Amy?
问大学几年级;回答 I'm a freshman. / I'm a sophomore.。year 开头的 /j/ 要发出来,别读成 ear(耳朵)。
美式常读成两个音节 SOPH-more,中间的 o 几乎不读;拼写难,记住 soph-o-more。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hello, you guys! This is the International Student Club.
lines.zh: (社团招新日,艾米在一个摊位后面招手)你们好!这里是国际学生社团。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Cool! We're international students, and we're freshmen.
lines.zh: 酷!我们是国际学生,都是大一新生。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: And Ethan? Is he an international student too?
lines.zh: 那伊森呢?他也是国际学生吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: No, he isn't. He's from California.

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: We aren't all international students, but we're friends!
lines.zh: 我们不全是国际学生,但我们是朋友!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Great! Please sign up. Write your name, email, and major.
lines.zh: 太好了!请报个名吧。写上你们的名字、邮箱和专业。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm a sophomore. They're sophomores too.
lines.zh: 我大二。(指着摊位后面的几个同学)他们也都是大二的。

questions.explainZh: 艾米问 Is he an international student too?,磊替他回答 No, he isn't. He's from California.(不,他不是。他是加州人。)
艾米说 I'm a sophomore.,sophomore 是大二学生;磊他们三个才是大一新生(freshmen)。
艾米说 Write your name, email, and major.(写上你们的名字、邮箱和专业。)
伊森说 Major? I don't know!(专业?我还不知道呢!)学生物的是索菲亚。

grammar.titleZh: we / they + are;否定 isn't 和 aren't
grammar.bodyZh: 说“我们”“他们”用 we are、they are,口语缩写成 we're、they're;一个人用 he is / she is。否定在 be 后面加 not,口语常缩写:is not = isn't,are not = aren't(I am not 只能缩成 I'm not)。纠正别人说错的信息,先否定、再说对的:No, he isn't. He's from California.。一般疑问句的简短回答也用 be:Are they freshmen? — Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.(肯定的简答不缩写,不说 Yes, they're.)。中文“我们是”“他们是”“他是”都用一个“是”,英语要跟着主语换 am / is / are,中国学生说快了容易说成 We is… 或 They is…。

examples.zh: 我们是大一新生,不是大二的。

examples.text: Is he an international student? — No, he isn't.
examples.zh: 他是国际学生吗?——不,他不是。

examples.text: Are they sophomores? — Yes, they are.

grammar.titleZh: 问年级 What year are you?;they're、their、there 读音一样
grammar.bodyZh: 问大学几年级说 What year are you?,回答 I'm a freshman.(大一)、I'm a sophomore.(大二);大三叫 junior,大四叫 senior(本单元第 8 课会学到)。这里也要加 a:I'm a sophomore.;说一群人用复数:We're freshmen.(freshman 的复数是 freshmen)。发音:we're 读 /wɪr/,they're 读 /ðer/。they're(他们是)、their(他们的)、there(那里)读音完全一样,听的时候靠上下文,写的时候别写错:They're my friends. / their names / They're there.。

examples.text: What year are you? — I'm a sophomore.
They're my friends. Their names are Sofia and Ethan.
examples.zh: 他们是我的朋友,他们叫索菲亚和伊森。

examples.text: Lei and Sofia are there. They're freshmen.
examples.zh: 磊和索菲亚在那儿,他们是大一新生。
